about: Untitled Goose Game is a slapstick-stealth-sandbox, where you are a goose let loose on an unsuspecting village.
Make your way around town, from peoples' back gardens to the high street shops to the village green, setting up pranks, stealing hats, honking a lot, and generally ruining everyone’s day.
• A town full of people just trying to get on with their day (you hate them)
AND ALSO: Oh dear! Two horrible geese!
summary: It's a lovely day in the village, and you are a horrible goose.
